```python
import pandas as pd

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
pages = {
    "Fire and Blood": 750,
    "Song of Solomon": 337,
    "The Lost Symbol": 509,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 224,
    "American Gods": 624,
    # Out of the Silent Planet intentionally left missing per provided mapping
    "The Andromeda Strain": 303,
    "Brave New World": 288,
    "Silence": 256,
    "The Shining": 659
}
words_per_page = 275

# Map pages
df['Pages'] = df['Title'].map(pages)

# Compute inclusive duration
df['Days'] = (df['End Date'] - df['Start Date']).dt.days + 1

# Exclude books without pages
excluded = df[df['Pages'].isna()]['Title'].tolist()
print("Excluded titles due to missing pages:", excluded)

# Estimate words/day
valid = df.dropna(subset=['Pages', 'Days']).copy()
valid['Estimated Words'] = valid['Pages'] * words_per_page
valid['Words per Day'] = valid['Estimated Words'] / valid['Days']

slowest = valid.loc[valid['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print(f"Slowest (estimated): {slowest['Title']}")
print(f"Words per Day: {slowest['Words per Day']:.2f}")
```
